messages:
sophie: FYI — Acme Corp (SUP-4821) reports delete API returning a 500 with a KMS error when trying to remove old customer logs. They want confirmation on deletion timing for audit logs + KMS-wrapped blobs. Customer is on Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS.

michael: Can you paste the exact curl + error and the repro steps so eng/security can triage? Also: are they calling our public API or the private control plane endpoint?

sophie: Repro steps from customer: 
1) curl -X DELETE 'https://private-acme.redwood.local/v1/retention/delete' 
   -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
   -d '{"org_id":"acme-123","since":"2023-01-01"}'
Response (truncated):
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{
  "error": "kms:AccessDenied",
  "message": "failed to decrypt data key for keyId=acme-kms-key-01"
}
```
Customer says this started after a key rotation last week.

ashley: Looking at logs: the delete request hits control-plane, then we call customer KMS to unwrap DEK for object deletion. I see repeated DECRYPT failures for keyId=acme-kms-key-01 around 2026-03-07T14:02:33Z. That matches rotation window. Need KMS admin logs from customer to see if policy change blocked our service principal. If they rotated without adding the service principal, AccessDenied is expected.

devon: Legal wants deletions paused while we confirm chain-of-custody. We can apply an org-level retention hold (non-destructive) immediately to prevent any background purge jobs. We need an approval from legal to initiate.

olivia: Legal approves a temporary hold for SUP-4821 until we get full audit export and KMS access confirmation. Please preserve audit logs and any object snapshots.

ashley: Commands we can run (internal control plane):
```
# set org-level hold (non-destructive)
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/admin/retention/hold \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>' \
  -d '{"org_id":"acme-123","reason":"legal_hold_SUP-4821","expires_at":"2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```
Response (example): `{"hold_id":"HOLD-9901","status":"applied"}`

ashley: For audit logs export: we can generate a compressed export of the last 24 months of audit events and push to a signed S3 location. ETA about 24 hours once hold is applied and we obtain KMS access to unwrap objects. If KMS access remains blocked, we can still export metadata and object manifests in 24h; actual content may require KMS cooperation (48–72h).

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: RETENTION-LOCK-2026-03-12 by devon — severity: medium — linked_ticket: SUP-4821

michael: Action items I tracked: 
1) @ashley apply org hold (HOLD-9901) — target: now
2) @sophie notify customer that deletion is paused and we are investigating — target: within 1h
3) @ashley coordinate with customer KMS admin to restore service principal permissions / provide KMS admin logs — ETA 24–72h
4) produce audit export and upload to signed S3 for legal — ETA 24–72h
5) update SUP-4821 with status and CC legal/security

sophie: I applied the hold and updated the ticket. Hold id: HOLD-9901. Customer notified: "Deletion paused; we're preparing audit export and coordinating KMS access." They acknowledged.

devon: Note for legal/compliance: default audit log retention for this plan is 90 days. Custom retention settings were in place for Acme (365 days) but purging jobs run nightly. Because of the hold we will cancel scheduled purge for the org. KMS/HSM retention nuances: if the customer requests final destruction later, we must document whether the wrapped keys are destroyed — some HSM vendors have a delayed unescape/grace period up to 30 days. We'll need to coordinate with the customer's HSM vendor to prove key destruction if required.

olivia: Good — legal will prepare a preservation notice to the customer and provide wording for the support reply. Also confirm that exported audit logs include signer identity + timestamps; if anything's missing, we need an action from eng to include it.

ashley: Confirmed export includes signer identity and request_id for traceability. If we regain KMS unwrap access, we can produce full object exports within 48h. If not, we'll provide manifest + metadata now and escalate to account team to get KMS admin to whitelist our principal.

michael: I'll keep SUP-4821 updated and set a follow-up checkpoint in 24h. Thanks all — please @mention if you make changes to hold/export. :thumbsup:
